# External dependencies of the website. scripts/deps installs each
# line. A key step signs the manifest of a key directory, so it needs
# signify(1). The site build itself signs nothing. Homebrew names the
# port signify-osx.
tool pkg signify-osx
# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks, so the tool environment
# installs it before every other environment.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks

# fuguweb runs in the rotation workflow, beside a private key, so
# each version is pinned here and never resolved at run time
# (SITE-ROTATE-15). deps/SHA256.txt records the digest of each
# tarball below, and a recorded digest outranks the signature, so
# make deps of this repository reads no published key
# (SITE-ROTATE-32). A key step therefore runs while the site serves
# no key directory. The Fugu digest agrees with the signed SHA256
# manifest of that release. The FuguWeb release carries no manifest,
# and its digest agrees with the tarball that the release run built,
# measured on 2026-09-15.
#
# To bump a pin, edit the URL below, and then run this command:
#
#   scripts/deps --update-sums --force
#
# The command needs --force. A release with a signed SHA256 manifest
# makes 'scripts/deps --update-sums' alone skip the URL. It prints
# "skipped the signed entry", records nothing, and exits 0. A bump
# without --force therefore returns the entry to the signify tier,
# and a key step then needs the site that it writes.
#
# --force records the bytes that the server serves. After a bump of
# an unsigned release, compare the new digest with the tarball that
# the release run kept.
runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/download/v0.5.0/Fugu.tar.gz
runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/FuguWeb/releases/download/v0.6.1/App-FuguWeb.tar.gz
runtime pkg mandoc
runtime pkg lowdown

# Fugu::OpenPGP drives gpg(1), and it holds no other engine. An
# OpenPGP mint of a key directory therefore needs the package.
runtime pkg gnupg
